entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Order number is VF88-12-5B.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF88-12-5B. I see the order here for Mark Jennings, delivered on December 15th. To get this started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Look, I don't have time for a survey. My husband had a medical emergency right after it arrived and was in the hospital. He needed unexpected surgery. The box hasn't even been opened. Can you process the return or not?
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly hope he's recovering well. Of course, I can check on that return eligibility for you right away. Let me see... okay, it was delivered 23 days ago.
So, according to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Great. Finally. What do I do next?

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox in a moment. Since you're a VIP member with us and given the circumstances, I've also made sure any return fees are waived. Just attach that label to the box and drop it at any post office.
Okay, I see the email. That's fine. Thank you.

You're most welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to the original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
